column3: Close to the Hebrew in sense; “double to sound wisdom” is rendered “double your prudence,” and “God causes you to forget some of your iniquity” “God exacts from you Less than your iniquity deserves.”
Close to the Hebrew; “summons an assembly” is rendered “gathers to judgment.”
NKJV turns “and he does not consider [it]” into a question, “Will He not then consider it?”
Close to the Hebrew; “it will be dark” is rendered concessively, “Though you were dark.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְחָפַרְתָּ (“you will look around / dig”) is rendered “you would dig around you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a breathing out of life” is rendered “loss of life.”
